Subject: Quality of data entered in Legal Dashboard - regarding

Ref: Head Office Letters of even No. LC/9(13)2013/ACC Pending
Ref./16074, both dated 13.07.2015 on the subjects of: (i) Role &
Responsibility of Nodal Officer in updating the Legal Dashboard; (ii)
Quality of data entry in Legal Dashboard in view of the forthcoming
Monsoon Session of the Parliament (copies attached)

Sir

While reviewing the data entered by the offices under your jurisdiction, it is
seen that the quality of data entered is not up to the mark. The following
shortcomings have been noted in the data downloaded from Legal Dashboard on
30.11.2015:-

S.No. | Source Data Field 7% of  missing/
poor data

i. Latest Date of Hearing 34% *

23 Counter Reply not filed where | 31%
CBT/UoI/EPFO or its officers are
Respondent

3 Counter Reply filed but date of filing of | ( 08%
Reply is missing or wrong

4. Subject Matter of the case is wrong or | 19% |
missing

* In addition, it is seen from the data entered by your offices that in 08.7%
cases no hearing has taken place after 2010, i.e, the last date of hearing was
between 1980-2010. This also needs to be checked.

2. Besides above, the quantity and quality of data with respect to “Disposed”

cases is also poor and needs substantial improvement.

33 Hence, you are once again requested to pay personal attention in ensuring
that the offices under your jurisdiction enter complete and correct data in Legal

Dashboard within the time specified in the Circulars under reference.

4. I reiterate the directions of CPFC that all ACCs and OICs should log-in to
the Legal Dashboard at least once a day to check the progress of data entry in
Legal Dashboard by the Nodal Officers and other concerned officials.

Youfs faithfully,

(M. Varghese)
Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner-I (Legal)
